{{Top|leg}}
The '''Horizon''' was the name for the boundary of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. It marked the points at which the accuracy of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps using [[Astrocartography|astrocartographic]] data about a month old fell below [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputers]]' safe margin of error&mdash;a product of the density of [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] bodies and stellar velocities in the Deep Core.

Rare exceptions were carved out for established [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] systems over, such as [[Ator/Legends|Ator]].
